profile.summary:
•	Hands-on experience in Camera and Graphics device driver on Android.
•	Developed and implemented Camera hardware layer for IFE (Image Front Engine) user driver. And designed and implemented R-BET (Register Bit Exactness Test) framework
•	Published two books about Android Framework in Korea. Wrote the Android SurfaceFlinger service part.
•	Had experience in for various Graphics device drivers such as Qualcomm Adreno, Imagination SGX, ARM Mali, and Samsung FIMG which supports EGL, OpenGLES 1.1 and OpenGLES2.0.
•	Developed, implemented and ported Graphics Driver on Android, Linux, RTOS (Nucleus OS) and BADA. 
•	Collaborating with lead global companies such as Samsung, LG, Vivo, Xiaomi, Sony and so on.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Verify Camera IQ(Image Quality) modules on new chipset
•	Developed and implemented R-BET(Register Bit Exactness Test) framework to compare and match the simulator and real device ISP(Image signal processing) output.
•	Addressed image quality issues in IFE(Image Front Engine) and BPS(Bayer Processing Segment) by solving logical problem in software user driver.
•	Memory optimization to avoid frequent allocation and free for each IQ module’s calculation.
•	Refactoring HWL (Hardware Layer) to support backward compatibility and support different type of triggering level.
•	Collaborating with Samsung, LG, One Plus, Vivo, Sony to launch their product and solving unexpected problem in their device.
